content: May 28, 2024 GrantSolutions for Grant Recipients Overview GrantSolutions is a grants management service that provides many tools for grant-related tasks. The Grants Management Module is one piece of the larger GrantSolutions system. CDC/ATSDR programs and business services offices use the Grants Management Module to manage grants and cooperative agreements. Resources Grant Recipient Actions, Roles, Notifications, and Training An overview of the Grants Management Module for grant recipients' training and alerts. Accessing Grants An overview of how to access grant files in GrantSolutions. Support and Contacts An overview of contacts and support for CDC's grant recipients and GrantSolutions help. Responsibilities Review information about who is responsible for Grants Management Module support functions.
